description: Turn auto-renew on or off for a domain's paid hosting (Secure Static Hosting, Cloud for WordPress or Link in Bio), the same switch as on the website. Off: the plan stays active until its expireDate and is not charged again (a trial ends without a charge); after that the hosting is removed, except a paid Link in Bio page, which moves to the free plan with its content kept. On: it renews at the plan price. The response's `message` says what happens next; tell the user. Free plans never renew (NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PRODUCT). get_hosting shows the current setting.

auto_renew.description: true to renew automatically, false to let the plan end at its expireDate.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

name: update_hosting_auto_renew
title: Update Hosting Auto Renew
